trust_decision.summary: The `file_name` / `file_names` strings in a folder dataset's metadata file (metadata.csv/jsonl/parquet) are untrusted dataset content and must resolve inside the directory containing that metadata file; at the pinned commit the only enforcement point is the normpath+join in FolderBasedBuilder._generate_examples.set_feature, which has no containment check at all, so a metadata value such as '../../etc/passwd' or an absolute path is joined verbatim and later opened by the feature decoder (Image/Audio/Video/Pdf/Nifti/Mesh).

landing_point.why: An engineer reading "path traversal through file_name metadata in folder-based builders" greps this module for where a metadata value becomes a path, and the only normpath/join of a metadata string in the whole tree is this branch (the `len(feature_path) == 0` leaf of set_feature).

fix_sites.entry_point: datasets.load_dataset("imagefolder"|"audiofolder"|"videofolder"|"meshfolder"|"pdffolder"|"niftifolder", data_dir=... / data_files=...) -> FolderBasedBuilder._split_generators -> _generate_examples (map-style via download_and_prepare and streaming via ExamplesIterable share this generator)
fix_sites.module_kind: packaged module builder: one shared GeneratorBasedBuilder base class behind six separate load_dataset module names

O3_reason_to_dismiss: none: no O2 site and no O8 route exists at the pinned commit; the only other way in (streaming IterableDataset) runs the same _generate_examples generator (builder.py:1583-1588), so there is nothing a solver could argue out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate relative reads that a blanket "reject '..' / reject '://'" fix breaks: subdirectory references ('subdir/file2.txt', './subdir/file2.txt') and metadata that lives inside a downloaded archive, where the joined value legitimately carries a `zip://<member>::<archive>` container URL (and windows paths are normalized with .replace('\\','/') first). Rejecting a '..' substring anywhere would also reject harmless names such as 'a..b.png'; checking the joined result for a scheme or for realpath containment breaks the archive route.

O6_input_shapes: plain single `file_name` string relative to the metadata directory
'./'-prefixed and subdirectory-relative values (legitimate, must keep working)
parent-directory traversal, at the start ('../x', '../../x') or hidden after a valid segment ('subdir/../../x', 'dummy/../../../etc/passwd')
backslash-separated values, normalized via .replace('\\','/') before the check
fsspec URL scheme inside the value ('file://', 'local://', any '://')
list-valued `file_names` / `*_file_names` (Sequence(Video), List(Image)): each element reaches the same leaf join, so the same guard covers it
nested/dict feature paths where _nested_apply descends to the empty leaf path before joining

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second path-valued metadata column resolved with the same join, e.g. `caption_file_name` / `annotation_file_name` per sample sidecar, or a `*_file_name` for an auxiliary index file
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the module already maps any `file_name` / `*_file_name` metadata key to a base feature (_set_feature, lines 218-223) and the docs advertise `*_file_name` columns, so a maintainer adding a sidecar/annotation path field is an ordinary extension of the same feature

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a third path shape (e.g. a struct/List(Struct) of file names, or a nested `parts` list) whose leaves only reach the join through _nested_apply with an empty feature_path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the `file_names` list branch was itself added after the single `file_name` branch, and the guard only holds because it sits at the leaf; a new shape is a natural next step and would be missed by a guard placed at the pop site

O9_family: CWE-22 path traversal: untrusted dataset metadata value turned into a filesystem path

O10_build.toolchain: setuptools + pyproject.toml; pip install -e '.[tests]' (pyarrow>=21.0.0, pandas, pyarrow, huggingface_hub, fsspec); make test == python -m pytest -n auto --dist=loadfile -s -v ./tests/
O10_build.project_tests: tests/packaged_modules/test_folder_based_builder.py drives FolderBasedBuilder directly (DummyFolderBasedBuilder over local tmp_path dirs, metadata.jsonl/csv/parquet, zip-archive fixtures), so the folder/metadata area is unit-tested offline; other tests in the same file use https://huggingface.co fixtures and need network, and the fix's new tests are local-only (hidden tests can mirror them offline).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: put the absolute/'..' check in the `len(feature_path) == 1` branch that pops `file_name`, which leaves the `file_names` list shape (Sequence(Video)/List(Image)) travelling to the leaf join with an empty feature_path and therefore still traversable; the guard has to sit at the join.
